例句

  1. During the math class, my cell phone began to ring, and the teacher severely scolded me. I regretted that I hadn’t turned it off.
    數學課上我的手機響了起來，老師狠狠罵了我一頓。我很後悔沒有把手機關掉。
  2. I fell asleep during the movie.
    我看電影的時候睡著了。
  3. We visited Okinawa during the summer vacation.
    我們在暑假期間去了沖繩。
  4. Please don't talk during the test.
    考試期間請不要講話。
  5. It snowed a lot during the night.
    夜裡下了很多雪。
  6. My phone rang while the teacher was talking.
    老師在講話的時候，我的手機響了。
  7. While we were in Okinawa, we swam every day.
    我們在沖繩的時候每天都游泳。
  8. I regret that I didn't study harder.
    我後悔我沒有更用功讀書。
  9. She regrets telling him the secret.
    她後悔把秘密告訴他。
  10. I regret not taking more pictures in Kyoto.
    我後悔在京都沒有多拍一些照片。
  11. Tom regrets that he bought such an expensive bike.
    Tom 後悔買了那麼貴的腳踏車。
  12. You won't regret visiting Taiwan.
    你不會後悔去台灣的。
  13. When I got to the station, the train had already left.
    我到車站的時候，火車已經開走了。
  14. I regretted that I had eaten so much.
    我後悔吃了那麼多。
  15. She told me that she had lost her key.
    她跟我說她把鑰匙弄丟了。
  16. I had never eaten mango shaved ice before I visited Taiwan.
    我去台灣之前從沒吃過芒果冰。
  17. When we arrived, the movie had already started.
    我們到的時候電影已經開始了。
  18. Can you turn off the music? I'm trying to sleep.
    你可以把音樂關掉嗎？我想睡覺。
  19. The TV is on. Can you turn it off?
    電視開著。你可以把它關掉嗎？
  20. Don't forget to turn off your phone in the library.
    在圖書館別忘了把手機關掉。
  21. It's dark. Let's turn the lights on.
    好暗。我們把燈打開吧。
  22. I turned on the radio to listen to the news.
    我打開收音機聽新聞。
  23. The air conditioner is too cold. I'll turn it off.
    冷氣太冷了。我來關掉。
  24. The lights are still on. Who will turn them off?
    燈還開著。誰要去關？
  25. During the trip, I regretted that I hadn't brought a warm coat.
    旅行期間，我後悔沒有帶一件保暖的外套。
  26. My phone rang during the meeting, so I turned it off.
    開會的時候我的手機響了，所以我就關機了。
  27. He regretted that he had said such a thing to his mother.
    他後悔對他媽媽說了那種話。
  28. I regretted not listening to my teacher.
    我後悔沒有聽老師的話。
  29. During lunch, Ann told me that she had passed the test.
    午餐時間，Ann 告訴我她通過了考試。
  30. When I got home, I found that I had left my umbrella on the train.
    我到家的時候，發現我把雨傘忘在火車上了。
  31. Turn the TV off before you go to bed.
    睡覺前把電視關掉。
  32. Can you turn the light off, please?
    可以請你把燈關掉嗎？
